title: Projects
mockNotice: Sample data. Available actions depend on your role and assignment.

worker.title: No projects yet
worker.description: A manager needs to add you to a project before it shows up here.

manager.title: No projects in your area
manager.description: Projects you are responsible for show up here.

admin.title: No projects yet
admin.description: Create the first project to start tracking time against it.

filtered.title: No projects match
filtered.description: Try another name or switch the status filter.

details.archivedNotice: This project is archived. New time can't be logged, but its entries and reports stay.

links.title: Project links
links.accessNote: Links open in a new tab. Access to the tracker doesn't grant access to Jira, GitHub or other services.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name} from {project}?
removeDialog.description: They can no longer log time to this project. Their logged time and their role in the system stay unchanged.

details.footer: Only assigned users can log time. Archived projects keep their history.

archiveDialog.title: Archive {name}?
archiveDialog.description: No one can log new time to it. Logged entries and reports stay, and an admin can restore it any time.

restoreDialog.title: Restore {name}?
restoreDialog.description: It moves back to Active and assigned people can log time again.

notFound.title: Project not found
notFound.description: It doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

addMember.title: Add member to {project}
addMember.description: Members can log time to this project. Their role in the system doesn't change.
addMember.managerScope: Only active people from your team are listed. Ask an admin to add someone else.
addMember.adminScope: Active people who aren't members yet.
addMember.nobodyLeft: Everyone available is already a member.

create.title: New project
create.description: After creating it you can add members and links on the project card.
create.managerSelfHint: You will be the responsible manager.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Purpose, scope, working notes and key agreements.
create.created: {name} created. Add members and links next.

edit.title: Edit project
edit.managerHint: Changing the manager doesn't reassign people in other projects.
edit.descriptionPlaceholder: Purpose, scope, working notes and key agreements.
edit.descriptionHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Start lines with "-" or "1." for lists. Don't paste passwords or tokens.
edit.archiveHint: Archiving stops new time entries. History and reports stay.
edit.lockedHint: Only an admin can change this field.
edit.noLinks: No links yet. Add Jira, the repository, docs, Figma or an environment.
edit.membershipNote: Project membership is managed in the Members block.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this project
conflict.description: Your changes were not saved, so theirs aren't overwritten. Load the latest version and apply your edits again.

leaveDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leaveDialog.description: Your edits to this project will be lost.
